name: catalog_promotions
description: A promotional price of one record's MONEY field within a local wall-clock window, for the whole catalog scope or one branch.
lifecycle: Created and deleted, never edited; windows of the same price whose branch scopes intersect never overlap. Deleted with the record.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the catalog (tenant key).
Catalog of the record, kept for per-catalog and per-field lookups; the module keeps it equal to the record's catalog.
MONEY field whose price is promoted.

columns.Null meaning: The promotion applies to the whole catalog scope.

columns.Meaning: Promotional price in the field currency's minor units, 0 to 10^12.
columns.Unit: minor units of the field's ISO 4217 currency

columns.Meaning: Local wall-clock start, inclusive, evaluated in each screen's time zone.
columns.Unit: local date and time without zone, minute precision
local date and time without zone, minute precision

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The catalog belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, created_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The creator is a membership of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, field_id) REFERENCES catalog_fields(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The field belongs to the same company; the module checks it belongs to the record's catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, record_id) REFERENCES catalog_records(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The record belongs to the same company; promotions are deleted with it.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((ends_at > starts_at) AND (date_trunc('minute'::text, starts_at) = starts_at) AND (date_trunc('minute'::text, ends_at) = ends_at)))
constraints.Purpose: Windows end after they start, at whole minutes.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_promotions_company_id_id_key ON public.catalog_promotions USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX catalog_promotions_field_idx ON public.catalog_promotions USING btree (company_id, catalog_id, field_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the promotions of a field for schema checks.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_promotions_price_idx ON public.catalog_promotions USING btree (company_id, record_id, field_id, starts_at)
constraints.Purpose: Reads a price's promotions by start for overlap checks and evaluation.
